speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: I did not ask for a flat cap on the monitoring budget, I asked for a strict return on investment for every new alert we deploy. You are still treating this as a cost center instead of a lever for our efficiency KPIs.
output.correction: You misread my comment on the dashboard spend as a request to cut features. I meant that if the monitoring does not directly reduce waste or improve availability, it does not belong in the roadmap.
